subject: The 72-hour test that saved 200 relationships
preview_text: You've got the app. Now try this 3-day challenge and see how many red flags you've been missing.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, a user named Sarah scanned a conversation that felt off. Three days later, she caught the pattern her gut was screaming about—gaslighting disguised as concern. She didn't break up. She just saw clearly for the first time. That's what this 3-day challenge is about.

Here's the deal: For the next 3 days, screenshot every conversation that makes you pause—even for a second. Run each one through the app. On day 3, open the Relationship Health Dashboard and look at the patterns. Most people see a toxicity score they didn't expect. The ones who finish say it feels like a weight lifted.

The challenge works because the app tracks across multiple conversations. One scan shows a moment. Three scans across 72 hours show the real story—love bombing, breadcrumbing, manipulation. The dashboard connects the dots so you don't have to.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI right now and scan your first conversation. Start the 72-hour test. See what you've been missing. P.S. The 200 users who finished this challenge? They all said the same thing: 'I wish I'd done this sooner.' Don't let that be you.
